question: Does OpenClaw intend every configured AI-provider and chat-retention path receiving these HealthKit-derived aggregates to operate strictly as the user-consented health or fitness service described by the feature?
rationale: This PR creates a new personal-health disclosure and retention boundary; tests can verify mechanics, but only maintainers and release/privacy owners can authorize the supported provider-use policy.

options.title: Approve bounded provider use
options.body: Define and own the provider-use and retention limits, then merge only after setup, disclosure, and signed-device proof gates pass.

options.title: Restrict provider disclosure
options.body: Keep the aggregates on device or limit them to provider paths that can guarantee the approved health or fitness use.

options.title: Defer HealthKit support
options.body: Pause the feature until the downstream disclosure and retention boundary can be guaranteed.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded provider use
recommendation.body: Define and own the provider-use and retention limits, then merge only after setup, disclosure, and signed-device proof gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows the broadest recent contribution across the exact iOS and gateway-policy surfaces, and the protected maintainer label indicates explicit repository-owner handling is expected.
